title: Later-Month Family Relief - Length of Active Duty Coverage Test
content:
**Desk guidance - TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, TRICARE Reserve Select.**

Active duty days count toward the later-month family relief only as the length of that coverage allows: where the active duty enrollment shows its coverage running more than 30 days from its effective date, those days count from the enrollment's effective date; where it shows its coverage running 30 days or fewer, no day counts; otherwise days count only after the plan's termination date.

The active duty enrollment is the purchaser's applied or active TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member enrollment; its length is the number of days from its effective date to the coverage end date (disenrollment date) its record shows. "Otherwise" covers no such enrollment, or one whose record shows no coverage end date.

| Length shown on the TRICARE Prime record | Days counting toward the later-month family relief |
|---|---|
| more than 30 days | from the enrollment's effective date |
| 30 days or fewer | none |
| no coverage end shown, or no applied or active enrollment | only the days after the plan's termination date |

*Hypothetical:* effective 9 July with a coverage end of 8 August is 30 days - no day counts; with a coverage end of 9 August, 31 days, days count from 9 July.
